deck_title: Clausius-Veach refractive solid-angle radiance scaling vs naive unscaled refraction etendue loss rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Rudolf Clausius (1864), Sidney Liebes (1969), and Eric Veach (SIGGRAPH 1996 / Ph.D. 1997) refractive radiance scaling (L_t = (n_t / n_i)^2 (1 - F) L_i, conserving optical basic radiance L / n^2 and locking R = 1.0000x across 17 relative IOR stations eta in [1.0, 3.0]) versus naive unscaled refraction (L_t = (1 - F) L_i, which drops relative radiance as 1 / eta^2 to 0.4444x in glass, 0.2500x at eta=2.0, and 0.1111x at eta=3.0 across 16/17 stations) and 64-ring Snell cone solid-angle quadrature.
